```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

SEARS 2.0 separates **permission to learn** from **permission to conclude**.
The package makes evidence authority explicit and maps mature evidence to one of four final states:
`SELECT_ONE`, `RETAIN_SET`, `NO_ACCEPTABLE_DOSE`, or `DEFER`.

```{r}
library(SEARS2)
d <- sears2_design()
d
```

## A two-dose final analysis

```{r}
fit <- sears2_analyze(
  strategy = "sears2",
  activity_successes = c(D2 = 18, D3 = 19),
  activity_n = c(D2 = 36, D3 = 36),
  tolerability_failures = c(D2 = 5, D3 = 12),
  tolerability_n = c(D2 = 36, D3 = 36),
  hard_admissible = c(D2 = TRUE, D3 = TRUE)
)
fit
```

The paper defaults are examples from the SEARS 2.0 methods study. They are not universal clinical constants.
